# Private PDF corpus

Place real-world PDFs in these gitignored directories:

- `accepted/before/`: valid original PDFs that must sanitize successfully
- `accepted/after/`: sanitized outputs generated by `script/verify`
- `rejected/`: malformed or encrypted PDFs that must fail sanitization

Run `script/verify` after adding files. Every run replaces the corresponding files under `accepted/after/` and rewrites `accepted/after/sanitization-report.json`. The report records before/after SHA-256 hashes, sizes, page counts, and the applied sanitization policy.

Compare each `before` and `after` visually and test text search, links, and forms. Do not commit confidential, licensed, or live malicious samples. Store such samples in your organization's approved restricted malware repository and copy them here only in an isolated test environment.
